lecture: Build targets read by assemble.py. Each entry: v = chosen value; plage = allowed range; statut = observe (measured, with its count in base) or convention (a choice made by the skill); src = where the value is read in references/cibles/<famille>.json (produit, ouverture, documentaire, bandeannonce). Times in seconds, positions as a share of the duration (0 = start, 1 = end). ; derive = the value comes from the source through a calculation stated in plain words. Check: python3 assemble.py --verifier-gabarits.
